messages.body_plain:
Dear All:
 
 
I am going to teach Sampling Methods course in Fall 2014. I am going to use the book by William Cochran, Sampling Techniques, 3rd Ed.
 
 
I am wondering if someone have R codes for examples and selected problems given in this textbook.
 
 
Thank you very much in advance.
 
Abou
 
 
 
 
==========================
AbouEl-Makarim Aboueissa, Ph.D.
